#### Seasonality

A plot of the seasonality of historical and projected rain, snowmelt, actual ET, runoff, recharge, and discharge.

```{r figure_12}
# Create Seasonal Dataframe
sum_cols <- c("aet_in_wbm","melt_in_wbm","pet_in_wbm","rain_in_wbm","runoff_in_wbm","snow_in_wbm", "precip_in_wbm")
mean_cols <- c("excess_water_in_wbm","tmean_C") 

seasonal_wbm <- wbm %>%
  dplyr::mutate(season = case_when(month(date) %in% c(12,1,2) ~ "Winter",
                                   month(date) %in% c(3,4,5) ~ "Spring",
                                   month(date) %in% c(6,7,8) ~ "Summer",
                                   month(date) %in% c(9,10,11) ~ "Fall")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(y = year(date)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-c(date,GCM)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(y,season,CF)%>%
  dplyr::summarize(
    across(all_of(sum_cols),sum),  # Sum of columns in sum_cols list
    across(all_of(mean_cols),mean),
    .groups = "keep") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(CF = factor(CF, levels = c("Historical", "Drier", "Wetter")))

seasonal_stats <- seasonal_wbm %>%
  dplyr::group_by(y, CF) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(runoff_fraction = as.numeric(100* runoff_in_wbm/sum(runoff_in_wbm))) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(CF, season) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(runoff = mean(runoff_in_wbm),
                   runoff_fraction = mean(runoff_fraction)) %>%
  #dplyr::filter(season %in% c("Spring", "Fall")) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(CF, season) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(runoff_fraction = sum(runoff_fraction),
                   runoff = mean(runoff)) 

hist_seasonal_stats <- seasonal_stats %>% dplyr::filter(CF == "Historical") %>%
  dplyr::rename(c("runoff_fraction_hist" = "runoff_fraction",
                  "runoff_hist" = "runoff")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(season, runoff_hist)

seasonal_stats <- seasonal_stats %>%
  left_join(hist_seasonal_stats , by = "season") %>%
  dplyr::filter(CF != "Historical") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(runoff_change = 100 * (runoff - runoff_hist) / runoff_hist)



hist_yrs <- c(1979, 2012)
fut_yrs <- c(2035, 2065)

seasonal_fig <- ggarrange(
  
  ggplot(seasonal_wbm %>% dplyr::filter(y >= hist_yrs[1] & y < hist_yrs[2] | y >= fut_yrs[1] & y < fut_yrs[2])) +
    geom_boxplot(aes(x = factor(season, levels = c("Winter", "Spring", "Summer", "Fall")), 
                     y = rain_in_wbm, fill = CF),
                 outlier.shape = NA,
                 linewidth = .2) +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(x = "", y = "Rain (in)") +
    scale_fill_manual("", values = c("Historical" = "#a9a9a9", "Drier" = "#c5312a","Wetter" = "#85b6dc")) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.margin = margin(t = -15, b = 0, l = 0, r = 0)),
  ggplot(seasonal_wbm %>% dplyr::filter(y >= hist_yrs[1] & y < hist_yrs[2] | y >= fut_yrs[1] & y < fut_yrs[2])) +
    geom_boxplot(aes(x = factor(season, levels = c("Winter", "Spring", "Summer", "Fall")),  
                     y = snow_in_wbm, fill = CF),
                 outlier.shape = NA,
                 linewidth = 0.2) +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(x = "", y = "Snowmelt (in)") +
    scale_fill_manual("", values = c("Historical" = "#a9a9a9", "Drier" = "#c5312a","Wetter" = "#85b6dc")) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.margin = margin(t = -15, b = 0, l = 0, r = 0)),
  ggplot(seasonal_wbm %>% dplyr::filter(y >= hist_yrs[1] & y < hist_yrs[2] | y >= fut_yrs[1] & y < fut_yrs[2])) +
    geom_boxplot(aes(x = factor(season, levels = c("Winter", "Spring", "Summer", "Fall")),  
                     y = aet_in_wbm, fill = CF),
                 outlier.shape = NA,
                 linewidth = 0.2) +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(x = "", y = "AET (in)") +
    scale_fill_manual("", values = c("Historical" = "#a9a9a9", "Drier" = "#c5312a","Wetter" = "#85b6dc")) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.margin = margin(t = -15, b = 0, l = 0, r = 0)),
  ggplot(seasonal_wbm %>% dplyr::filter(y >= hist_yrs[1] & y < hist_yrs[2] | y >= fut_yrs[1] & y < fut_yrs[2])) +
    geom_boxplot(aes(x = factor(season, levels = c("Winter", "Spring", "Summer", "Fall")),  
                     y = runoff_in_wbm, fill = CF),
                 outlier.shape = NA,
                 linewidth = 0.2) +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(x = "", y = "Runoff (in)") +
    scale_fill_manual("", values = c("Historical" = "#a9a9a9", "Drier" = "#c5312a","Wetter" = "#85b6dc")) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.margin = margin(t = -15, b = 0, l = 0, r = 0)),
  common.legend = TRUE, legend = "bottom", nrow = 2, ncol = 2
)
```

##### Figure 13

A plot of the fraction of snowmelt-derived runoff plotted through time across climate futures:

```{r figure_13}

snowmelt_stats_d <- wbm %>%
  dplyr::filter(year(date) <= 2012 | year(date) >= 2035, 
                year(date) < 2065) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(melt_run = (melt_in_wbm / (melt_in_wbm + rain_in_wbm)) * runoff_in_wbm,
                              rain_run = (rain_in_wbm / (melt_in_wbm + rain_in_wbm)) * runoff_in_wbm,
                              snow_frac_precip = (precip_in_wbm - rain_in_wbm) / precip_in_wbm,
                              melt_frac = melt_run / (melt_run + rain_run),
                              rain_frac = rain_run/ (melt_run + rain_run),
                              doy = yday(date)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(doy, CF) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(melt_frac_min = min(melt_frac, na.rm = TRUE),
                   melt_frac_mean = mean(melt_frac, na.rm = TRUE),
                   melt_frac_max = max(melt_frac, na.rm = TRUE),
                   snow_frac_precip_min = min(snow_frac_precip, na.rm = TRUE),
                   snow_frac_precip_mean = mean(snow_frac_precip, na.rm = TRUE),
                   snow_frac_precip_max = max(snow_frac_precip, na.rm = TRUE),
                   snowmelt = mean(melt_in_wbm),
                   discharge = mean(discharge_gpm)) %>%
  group_by(CF) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(snowmelt_mov = data.table::frollmean(snowmelt, 5, align = c("center"), na.rm = TRUE),
                discharge_mov = data.table::frollmean(discharge, 5, align = c("center"), na.rm = TRUE),
                doy_date = as.Date(doy, origin = "2019-12-31"))


peak_melt <- snowmelt_stats_d %>%
  slice_max(snowmelt_mov)

peak_discharge <- snowmelt_stats_d %>%
  slice_max(discharge_mov)

# Snowmelt timing figure
sm_timing_fig <- ggplot(snowmelt_stats_d, aes(x = doy_date, color = CF)) +
  geom_point(aes(y = snowmelt), alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_line(aes(y = snowmelt_mov, group = CF), linewidth = 2, color = "black", lineend = "round") +
  geom_line(aes(y = snowmelt_mov), linewidth = 1.5, lineend = "round") +
  geom_vline(data = peak_melt, aes(color = CF, xintercept = doy_date, linetype = "Peak Melt"), lwd = 1.5, alpha = 0.5) +
  theme_bw() +
  scale_color_manual("DOY Mean & \n10-Year \nRolling Mean", values = c("Historical" = nps_pal$grey, "Drier" = nps_pal$red, "Wetter" = nps_pal$blue)) +
  scale_linetype_manual("", values = c(1)) +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "1 month", date_labels = "%b %d") +
  labs(y = "Mean Daily Snowmelt (in)", x = "") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.margin = margin(t = -15, b = 0, l = 0, r = 0))
sm_timing_fig
```

#### Demand vs Supply

```{r}

pdat <- monthly_supply_proportions %>% 
           dplyr::mutate(month_date = ifelse(CF == "Historical", month_date - years(4), month_date + years(50))) %>%
           dplyr::left_join(monthly_use_long, 
                              by = "month_date") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(month_date = as.Date(month_date),
                CF = factor(CF,levels=c("Historical","Drier","Wetter")))


  #Plot historical demand:supply
  ggplot(pdat) +
  # Supply
  geom_ribbon(aes(x = month_date, ymin = monthly_supply_cf_min, ymax = monthly_supply_cf_max, fill = CF), 
               alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_line(aes(x = month_date, y = monthly_supply_cf, group = CF), 
             color = "black", lineend = "round", lwd = 2) +
  geom_line(aes(x = month_date, y = monthly_supply_cf, color = CF,  linetype = "Supply"), 
              lineend = "round", lwd = 1) +
  # Demand
  geom_ribbon_pattern(aes(x = month_date, ymin = low_use, ymax = high_use, pattern_fill = CF), 
    #pattern = 'stripe', 
    pattern_colour = NA, 
    pattern_density = 0.6,       # Controls the thickness of the stripes (0 to 1)
    pattern_spacing = 0.025,     # Controls the spacing/frequency of the stripes
    pattern_angle = 45,          # Controls the angle of the stripes (45 degrees)
    fill = "white",            # The background color of the ribbon (light red)
    alpha = 0.2,                  # Transparency
    pattern_alpha = 0.4,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_line(aes(x = month_date, y = mid_use, group = CF), 
            color = "black", lineend = "round", lwd = 2) +
     geom_line(aes(x = month_date, y = mid_use, group = CF), 
            color = "white", lineend = "round", lwd = 1) +
    geom_line(aes(x = month_date, y = mid_use, color = CF,  linetype = "Demand"), lwd = 1, lineend = "round") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = as.numeric(source_table_locs$storage_capacity_gallons) * gal_to_cf) +
    # Add an invisible line to create the legend entry
  #geom_point(aes(x = month_date, y = fut_mean*NA, color = "Historical GAM", fill = "Historical Gam"), pch = 21) +
    theme_bw() +
   scale_color_manual("", values = c("Historical" = nps_pal$grey, "Drier" = nps_pal$red, "Wetter" = nps_pal$blue)) +
  scale_fill_manual("", values = c("Historical" = nps_pal$grey, "Drier" = nps_pal$red, "Wetter" = nps_pal$blue)) +
    scale_pattern_fill_manual("", values = c("Historical" = nps_pal$grey, "Drier" = nps_pal$red, "Wetter" = nps_pal$blue)) +
    scale_linetype_manual("", values = c(2,1)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_number(scale = 1e-3, suffix = "K")) +
    labs(x = "", y = "Monthly Use (CF)") +
  scale_x_date(labels = date_format("%b")) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.margin = margin(t = -15, b = 0, l = 0, r = 0)) +
  facet_wrap(~CF, scales = "free")
  
  
  pdat2 <- pdat %>%
    dplyr::mutate(ds_mid = mid_use/monthly_supply_cf,
                  ds_low = low_use/monthly_supply_cf,
                  ds_high = high_use/monthly_supply_cf)
  
monthly_ds_fig <-  ggplot(pdat2) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(x = month_date, ymin = ds_low, ymax = ds_high, fill = CF), alpha = 0.4) +
    geom_line(aes(x = month_date, y = ds_mid, group = CF), linewidth = 2, color = "black", lineend = "round") +
    geom_line(aes(x = month_date, y = ds_mid, color = CF), linewidth = 1, lineend = "round") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 1) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0.2, linetype = 2) +
    #geom_hline(yintercept = 1) +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(x = "", y = "Monthly D:S") +
    scale_x_date(labels = date_format("%b")) +
    scale_y_log10() +
    scale_color_manual("", values = c("Historical" = nps_pal$grey, "Drier" = nps_pal$red, "Wetter" = nps_pal$blue)) +
    scale_fill_manual("", values = c("Historical" = nps_pal$grey, "Drier" = nps_pal$red, "Wetter" = nps_pal$blue)) +
    facet_wrap(~CF, scales = "free_x")
  
annual_ds_fig <- ggplot(DS_df %>% dplyr::mutate(CF = factor(CF,levels=c("Historical","Drier","Wetter"))), aes(x = year)) +
   #geom_rect(aes(xmin = 2035, xmax = 2065, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf),
  #          fill = "grey85", linewidth = 0,  alpha = .1) + 
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymax = DS_stress, ymin = DS, fill = CF), alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_line(aes(y = DS, group = CF), color = "black", linewidth = 2, lineend = "round") +
  geom_line(aes(y = DS, color = CF), linewidth = 1, lineend = "round") +
    theme_bw() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0.2, linetype = 2) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  scale_color_manual("", values = c("Historical" = nps_pal$grey, "Drier" = nps_pal$red, "Wetter" = nps_pal$blue)) +
  scale_fill_manual("", values = c("Historical" = nps_pal$grey, "Drier" = nps_pal$red, "Wetter" = nps_pal$blue)) +
  labs(x = "", y = "Annual D:S") +
  facet_wrap(~CF, scales = "free_x")

storage_supply_demand_fig <- ggplot(monthly_use %>% 
         dplyr::mutate(year = year(ym),
                       CF_label = paste0(CF, " Supply + Storage")) %>%
         dplyr::filter(year %in% c(2023, 2050, 2070)) %>%
         dplyr::group_by(CF, year) %>%
         dplyr::mutate(cume_use = cumsum(monthly_use_mid),
                       cume_use_low = cumsum(monthly_use_low),

                       cume_sup = cumsum(discharge_cf)), aes(x = ym)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = cume_use_low, ymax = cume_use_high), alpha = 0.2) +

  geom_line(aes(y = cume_use, color = "Demand"), lineend = "round", linewidth = 1.5) +
  geom_line(aes(y = cume_sup + storage_vol, group = CF_label), lineend = "round", linewidth = 2, color = "black") +
  geom_line(aes(y = cume_sup + storage_vol, color = CF_label), lineend = "round", linewidth = 1.5) +
  #scale_y_log10() +
  #geom_line(aes(y = cume_sup + storage_vol, color = CF_label), lineend = "round", linewidth = 1, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_number(scale = 1e-3, suffix = "K")) +
  facet_wrap(~year, scales = "free_x") +
  scale_x_date(labels = date_format("%b")) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.margin = margin(t = -15, b = 0, l = 0, r = 0)) +
  labs(x = "", y = "Cumulative Supply + Storage\n & Demand (CF)") +
  scale_color_manual("", values = c("gray80", nps_pal$red, "black", nps_pal$blue, nps_pal$red))
```

```{r snotel_figs}
  scale_color_manual("", values = c("black", "red", "purple"))


ggplot(blowhard_mtn_d %>%
         dplyr::mutate(doy = yday(date),
                       doy_date = as.Date(doy, origin = "2019-12-31")) %>%
         dplyr::group_by(doy_date) %>%
         dplyr::summarize(snwd = mean(snwd, na.rm = TRUE),

       aes(x = doy_date, y = snwd)) +

# Snotel and WBM
pdat <- snotel_tidy %>%
  dplyr::filter(name == "Brian Head") %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  left_join(wbm, by = "date") %>%
  dplyr::filter(year(date) < 2024) %>%
  dplyr::select(c(date, snowpack_in_wbm, wteq_i)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(date) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(snowpack_in_wbm, wteq_i), names_to = "vars", values_to = "vals") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(vars = ifelse(vars == "snowpack_in_wbm", "WBM", "SNOTEL")) %>%
  bind_rows(data.frame(date = NA, vars = "Blowhard Weather Station", vals = NA))

p1 <- ggplot(pdat) +
  geom_line(aes(x = date, y = vals, color = vars)) + 
  theme_bw() +
  scale_color_manual("", values = c("dodgerblue", "tomato", "black")) +
  labs(x = "", y = "Daily SWE (in)",
       title = "Brian Head SNOTEL vs NPS WBM") +
  theme( legend.position = "bottom")

p1

  left_join(wbm, by = "date") %>%
  dplyr::filter(year(date) > 1979) %>%
```
